skills.name: vcc-web-design
skills.title: Web design
skills.description: Plan, review, or improve a website for its audience and task. Use function-first design, Modern Web Guidance, native browser features, responsive layout, accessibility, performance evidence, and tested compatibility.

skills.title: SecureVCC
